name: ImagineVid AI Generation
description: Generate images, videos, and music through an OAuth-protected MCP and CLI gateway with live quotes and explicit credit approval.

skills.name: Model Discovery
skills.description: Lists current ImagineVid image, video, and music capabilities with stable IDs, fields, constraints, and estimates.

skills.name: Credit Quote
skills.description: Validates capability values and returns an authoritative server quote before any generation can spend credits.

skills.name: Approved Generation
skills.description: Starts one idempotent generation only after the human confirms the exact quote and request details.

skills.name: Result Polling
skills.description: Polls an owned generation and returns safe status, progress, and result metadata without exposing provider internals.
